Choose the matching cover
Use atomic-launch-widescreen-cover.png, atomic-launch-square-cover.png or atomic-launch-vertical-cover.png from 06-social. These clean opening designs include the logo and website address. Choose the cover explicitly when the publishing platform offers that option.
Captions and uploading
Upload the matching MP4. Square and vertical films already contain captions; avoid adding a duplicate caption layer. The product-demo SRT and VTT files share the same speech timing across all three formats. A plain-text transcript is included.
Use the current edition
The current kit supplies the three date-free launch formats and their opening-design covers. Refer to the public press room for the latest product imagery, downloadable documents and media files.
Editorial context
The footage records local sample-app interactions, with framing and a brief effect around the selected element. The standalone screenshots may show different demo states. Sample businesses and data are illustrations, not customer endorsements.
